Name: Nyapu-Style Across the Aisle
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
[b][i][color=#b4a7d6][size=3]Features[/size][/color][/i][/b]
Simply changes the portraits in [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/kcspace]kcspace[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37296]Across the Aisle - Pierre and Morris Rival Hearts[/url] to be Nyapu-Style, to keep consistency when using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url]!

I... I don't have much else to say. I just wanted the ultimate enemies to lovers to chu, but in cute.[line]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=3][b][i]Installation[/i][/b][/size][/color]
It is [i][b]not[/b][/i] a replacer! Unzip it anywhere in your mods folder and it will do its thing.
And if you want to uninstall it then just delete the folder, as simple as that!
[line]
[b][i][color=#b4a7d6][size=3]Credits[/size][/color][/i][/b]
All credits go to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu]nyapu[/url] for the Portraits and to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/kcspace]kcspace[/url] for Across the Aisle!
[line]
